title: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
abstract: arXiv:2610.32046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent \emph{test-time training} (TTT) frameworks have enabled open-weight large language models (LLMs) to outperform inference-only frameworks powered by frontier models on scientific discovery tasks. However, TTT introduces additional computational cost for online weight updates during the discovery process, making computational efficiency an important consideration when scaling to larger models. This motivates us to explore an efficient \emph{test-time adaptation} method for scientific discovery. We introduce \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} (TTME), a plug-and-play test-time adaptation method, as an alternative to TTT. TTME continually updates the external memory by distilling the experience to guide subsequent discovery without updating model weights. To have a clean comparison, we evaluate TTME and TTT under the same discovery framework, replacing only the test-time adaptation method. Our evaluation shows that TTME outperforms TTT

translated_title: 测试时记忆演化能否在科学发现中超越测试时训练？
translated_abstract: 近期的测试时训练（TTT）框架已使开放权重的大型语言模型（LLM）在科学发现任务上超越了由前沿模型驱动的仅推理框架。然而，TTT 在发现过程中需要在线更新模型权重，带来了额外的计算成本，使得在扩展到更大规模模型时计算效率成为一个重要的考量因素。这促使我们探索一种高效的面向科学发现的测试时适应方法。我们提出了测试时记忆演化（TTME），这是一种即插即用的测试时适应方法，作为 TTT 的替代方案。TTME 通过将经验蒸馏到外部记忆中并持续更新，以指导后续的发现过程，而无需更新模型权重。为了进行干净的对比，我们在相同的发现框架下评估 TTME 和 TTT，仅替换其中的测试时适应方法。我们的评估表明，TTME 的表现优于 TTT。
tldr: 提出测试时记忆演化（TTME），一种无需更新模型权重的即插即用测试时适应方法，通过持续演化外部记忆来积累经验，在科学发现任务上以更高的计算效率超越了测试时训练（TTT）。
en_tdlr: Introduces Test-Time Memory Evolution (TTME), a plug-and-play test-time adaptation method that continuously evolves external memory to distill experience without updating model weights, outperforming Test-Time Training (TTT) on scientific discovery tasks with greater computational efficiency.
